mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing a hot day with clear skies and temperatures reaching 92 degrees, feeling like 93 over by Verona Area High School. Tonight promises clear viewing for a waxing crescent moon and a visible pass of the International Space Station at 9:30 PM rising in the northwest.

In city news, Verona is continuing its push for local sustainability. Homeowners can take advantage of the Dane County Solar Group Buy program and Project Sunroof to explore solar energy options, while the water utility is highlighting its toilet rebate program and the Eye-on-Water tracking system to help residents save on utility bills.

Your upcoming community calendar features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie on Friday, July 17th. On Saturday, July 18th, don't miss the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Capitol Square or the Mount Horeb Art Fair, and look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In police news, on Wednesday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way where a 16-year-old driver failed to yield, resulting in minor injuries to a 74-year-old woman.

To cool off, stop by Culver's of Verona for today's delicious Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. They are open tonight until 10:30 PM, so you have plenty of time to grab a scoop. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Mint Cookie.
